title: [SEP-3] Billing countersignature and chain verification leak onto the open gossip mesh
description: Review finding SEP-3: Billing countersignature and chain verification leak onto the open gossip mesh (lens SEP). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:204; spec/13-encoding.md:62 (`kid` is the signer's DID URL); spec/10-relays.md:527, 608; spec/08-cross-space.md:96; vs ARCHITECTURE.md:157-160, 182. Fix: As proposed. `billingSig` is a §13.1.1 JWS whose `kid` names the billing DID, and announcements travel on the gossiped channel topic, so every mesh relay learns the billing DID behind each chain. 10:608 says agreements are "not gossiped", but this is their signer gossiped on every rotation. In the other direction, 10:527 requires dropping envelopes whose `accessSig` cannot be verified, and no mechanism introduces a chain to a peer relay without a registration. That leaves 08:96 unworkable. Q1 fixes that a CO countersigns. It does not fix that the countersigning key is the billing DID, so a per-registration key is open. Full text: notes/review/SEP-verified.md and notes/review/SEP.md.
